payload.text: 0180, hv's report and vc's word (2026-10-07): 0.1.9's CI is red on Ubuntu, arms 309 (0155) and 1086 (0158), reproduced 3 of 3 in an ubuntu:24.04 container that mirrors the job. Fix: the lint worker turns a death into an ordinary non-zero exit, so every xargs runs every file; and 0158's arm drops require_command expect, once its pty half is shown to run, and fail when it should, under util-linux script. Built in ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-dc/ci019/s, then the patch to vc.
